meta.caveat: Almost no economic time series exists for Accra alone. Everything marked Ghana is national and is labelled that way on purpose.

series.label: People in Greater Accra
series.source: Ghana Statistical Service census counts, 1960 to 2021
series.note: Census counts, not estimates. Six points in sixty-one years, and nothing in between.

series.label: People per square kilometre in Greater Accra
series.source: Census counts divided by the region's 3,245 km²
series.note: Honest division of two sourced numbers. The region's boundaries have changed over this period, which this cannot account for.
